units: <cite ref="Pesachim 3b">Pes. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>מאי דק׳</he> Ar. what is it he says? (ed. <he>מאי האי דקמן</he>; Ms. M. <he>מאי דקמן</he> what is this before us?).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 140b">B. Bath. 140ᵇ</cite> <he>מאי דק׳</he> (Var. <he>דקאמא</he>) Ar. (ed. <he>מאי קאמר</he>).

<cite ref="Ketubot 67b:7">Keth. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>אמר מאי דקאמא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>דקמא</he>) he (the beggar) said what he said (as mentioned before); [Rashi: <he>אמר רבא מאי דקַמָּא</he> Raba said, what is this before me?, i.e. what does this mean?]. [<cite ref="Sotah 2b">Sot. 2ᵇ</cite> bot., read as Rashi <he>מאי דקמָּא</he>.]
